name: Browser
short_desc: Service: Shared headless Chromium with a DevTools/Puppeteer endpoint for other apps.
author: chromedp (Kenneth Shaw) and the Chromium project; packaged by Humanity Labs
description: Unmodified chromedp/headless-shell (headless Chromium) pinned by digest. One shared browser that DeFleur Video and other apps drive with Puppeteer or the Chrome DevTools Protocol at http://browser:9222 inside Runtipi. No web page, no settings; stop the app to turn it off.
